# @clean-jsdoc-theme/docs-site

Documentation for @clean-jsdoc-theme/docs-site. Every page below links to its Markdown source.

## parity
- [parity](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/index.md)
- [Base](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/base/index.md): Base entity.
- [Widget](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/widget/index.md): A widget. Extends Base and implements Named.
- [Named](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/named/index.md): Something that can be named.
- [Point](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/point/index.md): A shape used across the fixtures.
- [Mode](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/mode/index.md): A config union type alias.
- [VERSION](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/version/index.md): A public constant.
- [configure](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/configure/index.md): Options object passed to configure. Inline object type — exercises structured-type expansion.
- [parse](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/parity/parse/index.md): Parse a value. Overloaded.

- [Nullable](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/nullable/index.md): Makes all properties of T optional and nullable
- [OmitByType](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/omitbytype/index.md): Omits properties of T that have values assignable to V
- [OptionalKeys](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/optionalkeys/index.md): Makes specific properties of T optional
- [PickByType](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/pickbytype/index.md): Picks properties of T that have values assignable to V
- [PromiseValue](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/promisevalue/index.md): Extracts the resolved type from a Promise
- [RequiredKeys](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/requiredkeys/index.md): Makes specific properties of T required
- [StrictUnion](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/strictunion/index.md): Strict union type (no extra properties)
- [TupleToUnion](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/tupletounion/index.md): Extracts string literal union from const array
- [UnionToIntersection](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/uniontointersection/index.md): Union to intersection type conversion
- [ValueOf](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/valueof/index.md): Value type of a record/object
- [assertNever](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/assertnever/index.md): Utility type for exhaustive switch statements
- [isDefined](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/isdefined/index.md): Type guard helper for checking if value is defined
- [isType](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/types-common/istype/index.md): Type guard for checking if value is a specific type

## utils
- [utils/array](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/index.md): Array utility functions
- [chunk](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/chunk/index.md): Chunks an array into smaller arrays of a specified size
- [difference](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/difference/index.md): Finds the difference between two arrays
- [first](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/first/index.md): Gets the first element of an array
- [flatten](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/flatten/index.md): Flattens a nested array to a specified depth
- [groupBy](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/groupby/index.md): Groups array elements by a key selector
- [intersection](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/intersection/index.md): Finds the intersection of two arrays
- [keyBy](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/keyby/index.md): Creates a lookup object from an array
- [last](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/last/index.md): Gets the last element of an array
- [partition](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/partition/index.md): Partitions an array into two arrays based on a predicate
- [range](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/range/index.md): Creates an array of numbers from start to end
- [sample](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/sample/index.md): Picks a random element from an array
- [sampleSize](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/samplesize/index.md): Picks multiple random elements from an array
- [shuffle](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/shuffle/index.md): Shuffles an array using Fisher-Yates algorithm
- [sortBy](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/sortby/index.md): Sorts an array by multiple criteria
- [union](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/union/index.md): Finds the union of two arrays
- [unique](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/unique/index.md): Removes duplicate elements from an array
- [zip](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-array/zip/index.md): Zips multiple arrays together
- [utils/date](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/index.md): Date and time utility functions
- [DateFormatOptions](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/dateformatoptions/index.md): Date format options
- [TIME_UNITS](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/time-units/index.md): Time units in milliseconds
- [addTime](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/addtime/index.md): Adds a duration to a date
- [dateDiff](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/datediff/index.md): Gets the difference between two dates in a specific unit
- [endOf](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/endof/index.md): Gets the end of a time period
- [formatDate](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/formatdate/index.md): Formats a date using Intl.DateTimeFormat
- [formatDateTime](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/formatdatetime/index.md): Formats a date and time together
- [formatDuration](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/formatduration/index.md): Formats a duration in milliseconds to a human-readable string
- [formatTime](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/formattime/index.md): Formats a time using Intl.DateTimeFormat
- [getRelativeTime](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/getrelativetime/index.md): Returns a relative time string (e.g., "3 days ago")
- [isBetween](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/isbetween/index.md): Checks if a date is between two other dates
- [isSameDay](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/issameday/index.md): Checks if two dates are on the same day
- [parseISODuration](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/parseisoduration/index.md): Parses an ISO 8601 duration string
- [startOf](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-date/startof/index.md): Gets the start of a time period

- [escapeHtml](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/escapehtml/index.md): Escapes HTML special characters in a string
- [interpolate](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/interpolate/index.md): String template interpolation
- [isBlank](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/isblank/index.md): Checks if a string is empty or contains only whitespace
- [kebabCase](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/kebabcase/index.md): Converts a string to kebab-case
- [padLeft](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/padleft/index.md): Pads a string on the left
- [padRight](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/padright/index.md): Pads a string on the right
- [pascalCase](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/pascalcase/index.md): Converts a string to PascalCase
- [slugify](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/slugify/index.md): Generates a slug from a string
- [snakeCase](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/snakecase/index.md): Converts a string to snake_case
- [truncate](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/truncate/index.md): Truncates a string to a specified length
- [unescapeHtml](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/unescapehtml/index.md): Unescapes HTML special characters in a string
- [wordWrap](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/module/utils-string/wordwrap/index.md): Wraps text to a specified width

- [Site home](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/typedoc-api-docs/): the rendered documentation site
